# oauth2_client_credentials — OAuth2 client_credentials end-to-end flow
# Verifies: the runner fetches an OAuth2 token and uses it as a bearer on data
# requests; the trace shows Authorization: <redacted> on all 3 data exchanges.
# The token endpoint is handled by the auth layer (not traced as an exchange).
# PageSize=2, EventsPerDrain=5 → 3 pages of cursor pagination.
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template. Both the base URL and the
# token_url default (http://localhost:9999) are replaced with $URL.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml oauth2_client_credentials
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"GET","query":{"cursor":"<ref cursor.token>"},"request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 172 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/oauth2/findings"}
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":2,"method":"GET","query":{"cursor":"<ref cursor.token>"},"request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 172 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/oauth2/findings"}
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":3,"method":"GET","query":{"cursor":"<ref cursor.token>"},"request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 101 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/oauth2/findings"}
